scope: Compact phase-45 implementation and bounded benchmark aggregation.

units.durations: milliseconds unless the field name ends in _us
units.counts_and_geometry: integer tokens, rows, pages, or samples
units.ratios: dimensionless selected divided by named control

current_q.producer: selected-packed current-Q attention telemetry and pager metrics
current_q.status: positive current-Q samples observed, but no candidate or promotion publication

natural_cold.fixture: incremental C>H natural recall/append with fresh recovery service
natural_cold.failure: No non-sentinel cold candidate, host-ready promotion, useful H2D, or selected cold-page use was observed.

control_placement.selected_packed: target K/V selected-packed route; Turbo4 K/V and native GPU MTP
control_placement.cpu_main_kv_gpu_weights_native_mtp: target K/V on CPU; model weights, draft, and native MTP on GPU
control_placement.all_gpu_pager_off: target K/V on GPU; pager off control

matched_controls.ratio_note: Descriptive ratios only; measured_cpu_speedup remains null because the receipt does not declare equivalent throughput.

measurement_failure.cause: 26 current-Q attention samples and positive attention publication were observed.

runtime_failure.cause: Fresh natural run failed at C=2807 on KV pager batch write reservation transaction; fresh managed restart completed the bounded recovery run.

selection_quality.cause: No non-sentinel cold candidate, promotion, useful H2D, or selected cold-page use.

uncertainty: Natural candidate, promotion, and selected cold-page use remain unproven beyond current-Q publication.
CPU-main-KV ratios are descriptive only; no equivalent-throughput CPU speedup is measured.
32K, 128K, and 256K values are not measurements because the natural-cold gate stopped the campaign.

next_actions.action: Repair or instrument candidate and promotion selection after current-Q publication, then rerun the bounded C>H natural fixture.
Retain the explicit CPU-main-KV control boundary and measured_cpu_speedup null until equivalent throughput is defined.
Run bounded 32K and conditional 128K validation only after cold candidate, useful H2D, selected cold use, and coherent recall pass.

deferred_scale.reason: Natural-cold eligibility failed; stopped at L8192 before 32K.
